name: The Billionaire’s Lost Love
overview: Billionaire Jax is forced to leave behind the woman he loves, Daniella, when family obligations demand he take over his father’s business abroad. Five years later, he returns determined to win back the bakery owner he never forgot. Just as they rekindle their romance, a conflict over Daniella’s beloved bakery drives them apart once again. Believing their love has come to an end, Jax leaves for good—unaware that Daniella is carrying his child.
